description: A shell script used for managing prplMesh processes, including starting, stopping, restarting, setting parameters, rolling logs, and handling configurations related to prplMesh components and their lifecycle.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal (default SIGTERM) to a specified prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process by name using start-stop-daemon.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process by name, attempting graceful termination and then KILL if necessary.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Handles rotating logs for prplMesh components, managing log files and sending USR1 signals to trigger log rotation.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from specified ODL files, with a default fallback.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in specified ODL files based on type.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the prplmesh platform database file exists, copying from shared location if necessary.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts various boolean or yes/no inputs to numeric 0 or 1.

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management and certification modes by updating platform db and ODL parameters.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts the prplMesh components based on the current configuration mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point handling command line arguments to control prplMesh processes.
